senses.gloss: m. (לעע, v. לוֹעַ) whiskers; מ׳ של שיבולין glume, the outer husk of grains.—Pl. מְלָעִין.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Oktzin 1:3">Ukts. I, 3</cite>; <cite ref="Chullin 119b">Ḥull. 119ᵇ</cite>, sq. <cite ref="M01467"><he>מְלָאי</he></cite>; <cite ref="Tosefta Uktsin 1:2">Tosef. Ukts. I, 2</cite> <he>מְלָאִין של שובלין</he> ed. Zuck. (R. S. to Ukts. l. c. <he>מלעין</he>; Var. Tosef. ed. Zuck. <he>סלעי׳</he>, corr. acc.).—Ḥull. l. c. <he>במלאי שבין המְלָאִים</he> when he takes hold of a number of glumes (which do not break).
